title: A2UI Component Specification
description: Schema for A2UI (Agent-to-UI) specifications. Codifies the structural rules described in references/domain/a2ui.md so that constraint validation has a deterministic source of truth. Cycle detection in the bindings graph is enforced by the normalization adapter, not by this schema (JSON Schema cannot express acyclicity).

version.description: Spec version marker, e.g. 'a2ui/v1'. Required at the top of every A2UI spec.

metadata.description: Optional spec-level metadata. Free-form; kept opaque to validators.

bindings.description: Top-level binding definitions referenced by components via { '$ref': '<binding-id>' }. Cycles between bindings are forbidden and detected at normalization time.

componentId.description: kebab-case component identifier, locally unique within its parent.

props.description: Component-type-specific properties. Validated by the per-type schema if one exists; otherwise treated as opaque.

bindings.description: Inline binding map for this component. Keys are prop names; values are either inline literals or { '$ref': '<binding-id>' } pointers into spec.bindings.

children.description: Ordered child components. Order is significant.

kind.description: Binding flavor. 'literal' is a static value; 'ref' points to another binding; 'expression' is a string the runtime evaluates.

value.description: Literal value when kind=literal. Any JSON-serializable type.

ref.description: Target binding id when kind=ref. Cycles are forbidden.

expression.description: Expression source when kind=expression. Runtime-defined grammar.
